Name: Petalite's Vale Of Flowers
Author: PetaliteVale
Description:
[center]Hi, This is my very first mod so I hope you'll enjoy it

This mod currently adds 4 differ﻿ent flowers, but I plan on adding more over time
The four [b]current[/b] flowers are:
- Snowdrops (Grows In Winter)
- Bleeding Hearts (Grows In Spring)
- Golden Dewdrops (Grows In Summer)
- Roses (Grows In Fall)

The [i]planned[/i] flowers are:
- Snapdragons
- Delphinium
- Persian Buttercup


I have a few other flowers in mind but I need to consider them a bit more before I decide.

P.S. I know the art is a bit inconsistent, I'm new to pixel art and I'm still trying to figure it out fully :)[/center]
